metadata.description: Mods that enforce and route the coordinator skills of this repository.

plugins.name: model-guard
plugins.description: Enforces model-mix on delegated launches: Sonnet for general-purpose and Plan agents launched without a model, Haiku 5.5 at medium effort for Explore agents and the haiku alias where it is Haiku 5.5 (Claude Code 2.1.293+ on the Anthropic API), Haiku 4.5 and Fable kept off delegated work, workflow width capped by today's profile, --model on cloud and headless launches, no new launches on a red budget or a paused 5-hour window; finishing open work always passes, and claude launches through Start-Process or cmd start are refused (run claude directly).

plugins.name: skill-router
plugins.description: Smart activation of skills with no model cost: suggests the skill a message calls for and asks once for the skills a workflow, agent, cloud launch, merge or mod edit needs; messages sent directly to workers and subagent calls are never held.

plugins.name: coordinator-lens
plugins.description: Makes the coordinator's work visible: budget color and pace, workers, merges, the round, the skill flow, night mode and decisions, in a band above the prompt, a /coord pane and card, and a few toasts. It observes only and spends nothing.
